source: source-scanned from tensorrt_llm package (os.getenv + StrEnum patterns) + Dynamo backend ArgGroups

TLLM_DISAGG_RUN_REMOTE_MPI_SESSION_CLIEN.display_name: Tllm Disagg Run Remote Mpi Session Client

TRTLLM_DISABLE_KV_CACHE_TRANSFER_OVERLAP.display_name: Trtllm Disable KV Cache Transfer Overlap

TRTLLM_KV_TRANSFER_NUM_THREADS.description: Number of worker threads for KV transfer queues (default: 1)

DYN_NAMESPACE.description: Dynamo namespace. If DYN_NAMESPACE_WORKER_SUFFIX is set, '-{suffix}' is appended to support multiple worker pools

DYN_ENDPOINT.description: Dynamo endpoint string in 'dyn://namespace.component.endpoint' format. Example: dyn://dynamo.backend.generate.

DYN_DISCOVERY_BACKEND.description: Discovery backend: kubernetes (K8s API), etcd (distributed KV), file (local filesystem), mem (in-memory). Etcd uses the ETCD_* env vars (e.g. ETCD_ENDPOINTS) for connection details. File uses root dir from env var DYN_FILE_KV or defaults to $TMPDIR/dynamo_store_kv.

DYN_REQUEST_PLANE.description: Determines how requests are distributed from routers to workers. 'tcp' is fastest.

DYN_CONNECTOR.description: [Deprecated for vLLM] Use --kv-transfer-config instead. For TRT-LLM, options: nixl, lmcache, kvbm, null, none.

DYN_DURABLE_KV_EVENTS.description: [Deprecated] Enable durable KV events using NATS JetStream instead of the local indexer. This option will be removed in a future release. The event-plane subscriber (local_indexer mode) is now the recommended path.

DYN_TOOL_CALL_PARSER.description: Tool call parser name for the model.

DYN_REASONING_PARSER.description: Reasoning parser name for the model. If not specified, no reasoning parsing is performed.

DYN_EXCLUDE_TOOLS_WHEN_TOOL_CHOICE_NONE.description: Exclude tool definitions from the chat template when tool_choice='none'. Prevents models from generating raw XML tool calls in the content field.
DYN_EXCLUDE_TOOLS_WHEN_TOOL_CHOICE_NONE.display_name: Dyn Exclude Tools When Tool Choice None

DYN_CUSTOM_JINJA_TEMPLATE.description: Path to a custom Jinja template file to override the model's default chat template. This template will take precedence over any template found in the model repository.

DYN_ENDPOINT_TYPES.description: Comma-separated list of endpoint types to enable. Options: 'chat', 'completions'. Use 'completions' for models without chat templates.

DYN_DUMP_CONFIG_TO.description: Dump resolved configuration to the specified file path.

DYN_MULTIMODAL_EMBEDDING_CACHE_CAPACITY_.description: Capacity of the multimodal embedding cache in GB. 0 = disabled.
DYN_MULTIMODAL_EMBEDDING_CACHE_CAPACITY_.display_name: Dyn Multimodal Embedding Cache Capacity Gb

DYN_OUTPUT_MODALITIES.description: Output modalities for omni/diffusion mode (e.g., --output-modalities text image audio video).

DYN_MEDIA_OUTPUT_FS_URL.description: Filesystem URL for storing generated images and videos (e.g. file:///tmp/dynamo_media, s3://bucket/path).

DYN_MEDIA_OUTPUT_HTTP_URL.description: Base URL for rewriting media file paths in responses (e.g. http://localhost:8000/media). If unset, returns raw filesystem paths.

DYN_TRTLLM_MODEL.description: Path to disk model or HuggingFace model identifier to load.

DYN_TRTLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME.description: Name to serve the model under. Defaults to deriving it from model path.

DYN_TRTLLM_ENABLE_ATTENTION_DP.description: Enable attention data parallelism. When enabled, attention_dp_size equals tensor_parallel_size.

DYN_TRTLLM_KV_BLOCK_SIZE.description: Size of a KV cache block.

DYN_TRTLLM_GPUS_PER_NODE.description: Number of GPUs per node. If not provided, inferred from the environment.

DYN_TRTLLM_MAX_BATCH_SIZE.description: Maximum number of requests that the engine can schedule.

DYN_TRTLLM_MAX_NUM_TOKENS.description: Maximum number of batched input tokens after padding is removed in each batch.

DYN_TRTLLM_MAX_SEQ_LEN.description: Maximum total length of one request, including prompt and outputs. If unspecified, the value is deduced from the model config.

DYN_TRTLLM_MAX_BEAM_WIDTH.description: Maximum number of beams for beam search decoding.

DYN_TRTLLM_FREE_GPU_MEMORY_FRACTION.description: Free GPU memory fraction reserved for KV Cache,  after model weights and buffers are allocated.
DYN_TRTLLM_FREE_GPU_MEMORY_FRACTION.display_name: Dyn Trtllm Free GPU Memory Fraction

DYN_TRTLLM_EXTRA_ENGINE_ARGS.description: Path to a YAML file containing additional keyword arguments to pass to the TRTLLM engine.

DYN_TRTLLM_OVERRIDE_ENGINE_ARGS.description: Python dictionary string to override specific engine arguments from the YAML file. Example: '{"tensor_parallel_size": 2, "kv_cache_config": {"enable_block_reuse": false}}'

DYN_TRTLLM_PUBLISH_EVENTS_AND_METRICS.description: If set, publish events and metrics to Dynamo components.
DYN_TRTLLM_PUBLISH_EVENTS_AND_METRICS.display_name: Dyn Trtllm Publish Events And Metrics

DYN_TRTLLM_LOAD_FORMAT.description: Model weight loading format passed to TensorRT-LLM (e.g. 'auto', 'gms').

DYN_TRTLLM_MODEL_LOADER_EXTRA_CONFIG.description: JSON object passed as extra config to the model loader (e.g. '{"gms_read_only": true}').
DYN_TRTLLM_MODEL_LOADER_EXTRA_CONFIG.display_name: Dyn Trtllm Model Loader Extra Config

DYN_TRTLLM_MODALITY.description: Modality to use for the model.

DYN_TRTLLM_ENCODE_ENDPOINT.description: Endpoint (in 'dyn://namespace.component.endpoint' format) for the encode worker.

DYN_TRTLLM_ALLOWED_LOCAL_MEDIA_PATH.description: Path to a directory that is allowed to be accessed by the model.
DYN_TRTLLM_ALLOWED_LOCAL_MEDIA_PATH.display_name: Dyn Trtllm Allowed Local Media Path

DYN_TRTLLM_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB.description: Maximum size of downloadable embedding files/Image URLs.
DYN_TRTLLM_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB.display_name: Dyn Trtllm Max File Size Mb

DYN_TRTLLM_FRONTEND_DECODING.description: Enable frontend decoding of multimodal images. When enabled, images are decoded in the Rust frontend and transferred to the backend via NIXL RDMA. Without this flag, images are decoded in the Python backend (default behavior).

DYN_TRTLLM_GUIDED_DECODING_BACKEND.description: Backend to use for guided decoding (structured output). Options: xgrammar, llguidance.

DYN_TRTLLM_DEFAULT_NUM_FRAMES.description: Default number of frames for video generation.

DYN_TRTLLM_DEFAULT_NUM_INFERENCE_STEPS.display_name: Dyn Trtllm Default Num Inference Steps

DYN_TRTLLM_TORCH_DTYPE.description: Torch dtype for model loading. bfloat16 recommended for Ampere+ GPUs.

DYN_TRTLLM_REVISION.description: HuggingFace Hub revision (branch, tag, or commit SHA) for model download.

DYN_TRTLLM_ENABLE_TEACACHE.description: Enable TeaCache optimization for faster generation.

DYN_TRTLLM_TEACACHE_USE_RET_STEPS.display_name: Dyn Trtllm Teacache Use Ret Steps

DYN_TRTLLM_ATTN_BACKEND.description: Attention backend for diffusion models. VANILLA = PyTorch SDPA, TRTLLM = TensorRT-LLM kernels.

DYN_TRTLLM_QUANT_ALGO.description: Quantization algorithm for diffusion models. BF16 weights are quantized on-the-fly during loading.

DYN_TRTLLM_QUANT_DYNAMIC.description: Enable dynamic weight quantization (quantize BF16 weights on-the-fly during loading).

DYN_TRTLLM_ENABLE_FULLGRAPH.description: Enable torch.compile fullgraph mode (stricter but potentially faster).

DYN_TRTLLM_FUSE_QKV.description: Enable QKV fusion for transformer attention layers.

DYN_TRTLLM_ENABLE_CUDA_GRAPH.description: Enable CUDA graph capture for transformer forward passes. Mutually exclusive with torch.compile.

DYN_TRTLLM_ENABLE_LAYERWISE_NVTX_MARKER.description: Enable per-layer NVTX markers for profiling with Nsight Systems.
DYN_TRTLLM_ENABLE_LAYERWISE_NVTX_MARKER.display_name: Dyn Trtllm Enable Layerwise Nvtx Marker

DYN_TRTLLM_ENABLE_ASYNC_CPU_OFFLOAD.description: Enable async CPU offload for memory efficiency.
DYN_TRTLLM_ENABLE_ASYNC_CPU_OFFLOAD.display_name: Dyn Trtllm Enable Async CPU Offload

DYN_TRTLLM_SKIP_COMPONENTS.description: Comma-separated list of pipeline components to skip loading. Valid values: transformer, vae, text_encoder, tokenizer, scheduler, image_encoder, image_processor.

DYNAMO_ENABLE_TEST_LOGITS_PROCESSOR.description: Optional test-only logits processing (enable with DYNAMO_ENABLE_TEST_LOGITS_PROCESSOR=1)

DYN_GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD_SECS.display_name: Dyn Graceful Shutdown Grace Period Secs

TLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN.description: Allow user to override the inferred max_seq_len with a warning.
TLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN.display_name: Tllm Allow Long Max Model Len

TLLM_AUTOTUNER_LOG_LEVEL_DEBUG_TO_INFO.description: Increase log level for AutoTuner associated logger`
TLLM_AUTOTUNER_LOG_LEVEL_DEBUG_TO_INFO.display_name: Tllm Autotuner Log Level Debug To Info

TLLM_DISABLE_ALLREDUCE_AUTOTUNE.description: In case that AutoTuner brings potential perf regression TODO: Remove this if no perf regression is observed.

TLLM_ENABLE_CACHE_TRANSFER_PERF_INFO.display_name: Tllm Enable Cache Transfer Perf Info

TLLM_KV_CACHE_MANAGER_V2_DEBUG.display_name: Tllm KV Cache Manager V2 Debug

TLLM_KV_TRANSFER_PERF_LOG_FILE.display_name: Tllm KV Transfer Perf Log File

TLLM_LINE_PROFILER_PATH.description: Skip line profiler during warmup/memory estimation phase to avoid saving incomplete results that would be overwritten anyway

TLLM_LLMAPI_ZMQ_PAIR.description: Check if PAIR mode is enabled via environment variable

TLLM_OVERRIDE_LAYER_NUM.description: If the layer number is overridden, it indicates that only a subset of layers are loaded. Prefetching all layers is unnecessary.

TLLM_PP_ASYNC_BROADCAST_SAMPLE_STATE.description: `TLLM_PP_ASYNC_BROADCAST_SAMPLE_STATE` controls whether to broadcast the sample state asynchronously. If true, the executor loop can broadcast and handle sample states asynchronously to achieve best perf. If false, the executor loop can only broadcast and handle each sample state in a pre-defined iteration. It is only for debugging purposes. Some tests can disable it to get a deterministic behavior.
TLLM_PP_ASYNC_BROADCAST_SAMPLE_STATE.display_name: Tllm Pp Async Broadcast Sample State

TLLM_PP_SCHEDULER_MAX_RETRY_COUNT.display_name: Tllm Pp Scheduler Max Retry Count

TLLM_PROFILING_TIMER.description: Timing backend: globaltimer kernel vs cuda events. TLLM_PROFILING_TIMER env var overrides auto-detection: "globaltimer" -> force globaltimer "cuda_event"  -> force cuda events unset/default -> auto-detect via confidential_compute_enabled()

TLLM_SPAWN_PROXY_PROCESS_IPC_ADDR.display_name: Tllm Spawn Proxy Process Ipc Addr

TLLM_SPAWN_PROXY_PROCESS_IPC_HMAC_KEY.display_name: Tllm Spawn Proxy Process Ipc Hmac Key

TLLM_TEST_MNNVL.description: Add a bypass so that we can run the unittest on single-node

TRTLLM_ALLREDUCE_FUSION_WORKSPACE_SIZE.description: Allow override via environment variable for edge cases

TRTLLM_CAN_USE_DEEP_EP.description: Try DeepEP (if enabled and weight dtype is bfloat16)

TRTLLM_DEEP_EP_DISABLE_P2P_FOR_LOW_LATEN.display_name: Trtllm Deep Ep Disable P2p For Low Latency Mode

TRTLLM_DISAGG_BENCHMARK_GEN_ONLY.description: For gen-only benchmarking, mark new gen request as transmission complete right away

TRTLLM_DISAGG_SERVER_DISABLE_GC.description: Disable GC by default When concurrency is high, the number of Python objects increases, so GC runs frequently and takes a long time to process. In this case, requests are not immediately forwarded to CTX workers and GEN workers, causing them to run with small batch sizes. Disabling GC can mitigate this problem. By testing this feature, we didn't observe significant RSS or VMS increment, and observed that `count0` (obtained by `gc.get_count()`) increases by fewer than 1,000 after every 200,000 requests, while the maximum value of `count0` exceeded 3,000,000 during the test.

TRTLLM_ENABLE_ATTENTION_NVFP4_OUTPUT.description: Default enabled, but allow manual disabling through `TRTLLM_ENABLE_ATTENTION_NVFP4_OUTPUT=0`

TRTLLM_ENABLE_DUMMY_ALLREDUCE.description: Debug function for eliminating imbalance during performance analysis.

TRTLLM_ENABLE_TRTLLM_GEN_ATTENTION.description: Enable TRTLLM-Gen attention backend via environment variable (default: off).

TRTLLM_EXAONE_EAGER_FUSION_ENABLED.description: MoE fusions are disabled by default in K-EXAONE since it may cause a slight accuracy drop due to numerical gap.

TRTLLM_FORCE_COMM_METHOD.description: Check if forced method is specified via environment variable

TRTLLM_GEN_FUSED_MOE_USE_FLASHINFER.display_name: Trtllm Gen Fused Moe Use Flashinfer

TRTLLM_KVCACHE_AWARE_ROUTER_HASH_TOKENS_.display_name: Trtllm Kvcache Aware Router Hash Tokens Per Block

TRTLLM_KVCACHE_TIME_OUTPUT_PATH.description: TODO: better way to enable metrics

TRTLLM_LOAD_KV_SCALES.description: Handle kv_scales for NVFP4 KV cache

TRTLLM_MAMBA2_MTP_USE_CUSTOM_OP.display_name: Trtllm Mamba2 Mtp Use Custom Op

TRTLLM_MLA_SHORT_SEQ_MHA_THRESHOLD.description: Short-sequence MHA optimization for DSA models: For short prefill sequences, use MHA (kv_b_proj expansion + standard attention) instead of the absorption path, which has overhead from extra BMMs and larger head_dim (kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim). Only active when rope_fusion is True (DSA with TrtllmAttention).
TRTLLM_MLA_SHORT_SEQ_MHA_THRESHOLD.display_name: Trtllm Mla Short Seq Mha Threshold

TRTLLM_MOE_FUSED_FC2_ALPHA.description: Environment variable to control fc2_alpha fusion into FC1's alpha_post. Default: disabled (0). Set to "1" to enable fusion (known accuracy issue under TP).

TRTLLM_PRINT_SKIP_SOFTMAX_STAT.description: Default disabled, but allow manual enabling through `TRTLLM_PRINT_SKIP_SOFTMAX_STAT=1`

TRTLLM_RAY_PER_WORKER_GPUS.description: When set to be a fraction, it allows Ray to schedule multiple actors on a single GPU for colocate use cases.

TRTLLM_USAGE_FORCE_ENABLED.description: Allow force-enable override for CI-based deployments
